title: Lesson 25: Do the English Speak English

segments.text: Lesson 25
segments.translation: 第25课

segments.text: Do the English Speak English
segments.translation: 英国人讲的是英语吗？

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: Do they speak English?
segments.translation: 他们说英语吗？

segments.text: Why does the writer not understand the porter?
segments.translation: 为什么作者听不懂搬运工的话？

segments.text: I arrived in London at last.
segments.translation: 我终于到了伦敦。

segments.text: The railway station was big, black and dark.
segments.translation: 火车站很大、很黑、很暗。

segments.text: I did not know the way to my hotel, so I asked a porter.
segments.translation: 我不知道去旅馆的路该怎么走，于是问了一个搬运工。

segments.text: I not only spoke English very carefully, but very clearly as well.
segments.translation: 我的英语讲得不但非常仔细，而且非常清楚。

segments.text: The porter, however, could not understand me.
segments.translation: 然而搬运工却听不懂我说的话。

segments.text: I repeated my question several times and at last he understood.
segments.translation: 我把问题重复了几遍，他终于听懂了。

segments.text: he answered me, but he spoke neither slowly nor clearly.
segments.translation: 他回答了我的问题，但他既不说得慢，也不说得清楚。

segments.text: 'I am a foreigner,' I said.
segments.translation: '我是个外国人，'我说。

segments.text: Then he spoke slowly, but I could not understand him.
segments.translation: 于是他说慢了，但我还是听不懂他说的话。

segments.text: My teacher never spoke English like that!
segments.translation: 我的老师从来不那样说英语！

segments.text: The porter and I looked at each other and smiled.
segments.translation: 搬运工和我相视一笑。

segments.text: Then he said something and I understood it.
segments.translation: 然后他说了些什么，我听懂了。

segments.text: 'You'll soon learn English!' he said.
segments.translation: '你会很快学会英语的！'他说。

segments.text: I wonder.
segments.translation: 我感到很奇怪。

segments.text: In England, each person speaks a different language.
segments.translation: 在英国，每个人说的英语都不一样。

segments.text: The English understand each other, but I don't understand them!
segments.translation: 英国人互相听得懂，我却听不懂他们说的话！
